table_name: Table 7B - Requirements for Firefighting Installations - For Educational Buildings
band_matching_convention: See table7a_residential.json for the shared convention and confidence-tagging rules.

bands.condition: Up to 45 m height, area 501-1000 sqm
Up to 45 m height, area 1001 sqm and above

bands.note: Refer to hydraulic-calculation note / Annex D provisions.

notes: If there are laboratories, AV/computer rooms, or auditoriums, they must be sprinklered and protection level upgrades to CL-3.
If the building has a basement requiring sprinkler protection, protection level upgrades to CL-3.
If the building has EV parks in podium/basement, must be sprinklered and comply with CL-5.
Rate-of-rise heat detection required in EV parking/charging areas; smoke detectors in all basements except ICE vehicle parks (which get CO sensors).
If building height exceeds 60 m, hydraulic calculations with multi-level pumping/storage and gravity-redundant down-comer should be considered; pumps should not exceed 12 bar shutoff pressure.
Pump pressure/quantity must be supported by hydraulic calculations.
Cluster of up to 5 buildings (not closer than 9 m): 2500 lpm at 10 bar common pumping, 255000 litre storage; CL-5 required if closer than 9 m or shared EV basement.
Multi-level pumping/storage per SLD for cluster buildings over 45 m; water storage at every 45 m above per building.
If cluster exceeds 5 buildings, another equivalent pump/storage set required (max 2 sets recommended).
